business.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
business.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]

signals: Profit growing faster than sales — leverage in the model
CWIP is 21% of fixed assets — capex in flight

items.statement: Mobile volumes to close FY27 at 33–34 million units, excluding Vivo JV
items.quote: So, as far as the volumes are concerned, as we mentioned that in this year we should close somewhere between 33 to 34 million without Vivo.

items.statement: Vivo JV capex expected at Rs 300–350 crore
items.quote: So the commercials for Vivo JV are still being finalized, but we estimate that the expected CAPEX is going to be somewhere around INR 300 crores to INR 350-odd crores.

items.statement: Display fab capex of roughly Rs 1,000 crore
items.quote: And as far as display is concerned, we will be putting up a CAPEX of almost closer to INR 1,000 odd crores.

items.statement: Display and camera backward integration to add 80–100 bps to margins over two years
items.quote: So, clearly both display and camera put together, we feel that over a period of next 2 years, we should be able to expand our margins by 80 to 100 bps.

items.statement: IT hardware: 1.3–1.4 million units this year, Rs 6,000–6,500 crore revenue
items.quote: Yes, so basically, just to add, Renu, this year we are looking at a volume of closer to 1.3-1.4 million, which will translate into revenues of closer to INR 6,000-6,500 crores.

items.statement: Camera module capacity to reach 180–190 million units a year by next fiscal
items.quote: We have already expanded our capacities from 80 million to 120 million annually, along with deepened manufacturing, which is margin accretive, and will further expand its capacity to 180 to 190 million units annually by next fiscal.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 growth of 20–25% over Q1
items.quote: So quarter 2 against quarter 1, we are expecting a 20%, 25% kind of a growth.

items.statement: Smartphone volumes up 20–25% quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter- on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.

items.statement: Mobile order book for Q2 of 9–9.2 million units
items.quote: Now our order book for Q2 to be precise, is somewhere around 9 million to 9.2 million.

items.statement: Q Tech camera module capacity from 70 to 180–190 million a year within 15–18 months
items.quote: We are expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to a captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target of about Rs 56,000 crore, excluding Vivo, with flat mobile volumes
items.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.

items.statement: Revenue growth of at least 12–15% in FY27
items.quote: So we expect Pankaj to -- that the revenue growth should be at least 12% to 15% higher, if not more.

items.statement: Smartphone selling prices up 12–15% with high-double-digit sequential volume growth
items.quote: Over the past few weeks, supply-demand dynamics are becoming more balanced, and we are beginning to see an improvement in customer ordering pattern, and we expect a high-double- digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.

items.statement: Lighting JV revenues to roughly double in FY27
items.quote: Lighting, the JV with Signify continues to deliver strong revenue growth, and we expect the revenues to grow almost to 2x in the current fiscal.

items.statement: Segment revenues to triple in FY27
items.quote: The segment delivered a healthy performance for the quarter under review, and we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year with a huge uptake in order books from all customers.

items.statement: Confident of Rs 4,000 crore revenue from this business in FY27
items.quote: So we are confident of touching this revenue figure of INR4,000 crores in the current fiscal.

items.statement: Mobile capacity to rise from 24 to 50–55 million units over two years
items.quote: As I've shared, finally, the capacity buildup for mobile over the next 2 years is going to be from 24 million to almost 50 million, 55 million.

items.statement: New business expected to earn double-digit margins
items.quote: We feel that it should be double-digit margin.

items.statement: FY26 capex of about Rs 1,100–1,150 crore
items.quote: So we will do a capex of closer to INR1,100 crores, INR1,150-odd crores.

items.statement: Mobile phone business margin of 2.8–3.2%
items.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 smartphone volumes of 7–7.5 million
items.quote: Q4 volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million.

items.statement: FY27 mobile volumes of 60–65 million units on a conservative basis
items.quote: Please appreciate on a conservative basis, the steps that we are taking for growth and consolidation in the mobile business for us, we should be even a conservative basis, somewhere around 60 million, 65 million units.

items.statement: This business to reach about Rs 5,200 crore revenue in FY26
items.quote: This year, we should have revenues close to INR5,200 crores.

items.statement: Q Tech camera module capex of Rs 250–300 crore
items.quote: In Q Tech, the camera modules capex intensity should be closer to INR250 crores, INR300-odd crores.

items.statement: Camera module volumes from 40 million to 190–200 million units a year
items.quote: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited January 29, 2026 and target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

items.statement: Double-digit growth expected this year (FY26)
items.quote: But my sense is it should be a double-digit kind of growth this year.

items.statement: This business targeting Rs 1,200–1,300 crore revenue in FY26
items.quote: So, this year, we are targeting revenues of almost INR 1,200 crores to Rs. 1,300 crores in this business.

items.statement: JV volumes of 8–10 million next fiscal, within 60–65 million total mobile volumes
items.quote: We feel that the volumes in this JV for the next fiscal should be somewhere around 8 to 10 million, and this is going to be a part of 60 million, 65 million that we are talking about for next fiscal.

items.statement: Camera modules from 14 million to 190–200 million units within 2.5–3 years
items.quote: And we have already gave you guidance that this 14 million units and the kind of order book that we have on mobile phones, we can take it to 190 million, 200 million in the next 2.5, 3 years.

items.statement: Expected volumes of about 0.5 million units a month
items.quote: The expected volumes are in the range of around 0.5 million per month.
